services.e-commerce.name: E-commerce
services.e-commerce.pain: Still closing sales over the phone? Upgrade your business with an online store connected to Shopify, with integrated payments and SEO included. 100% customizable design.
services.e-commerce.benefit: Give customers one place to pick a product, pay and complete their order.
services.e-commerce.scope: Customizable design and SEO included. Manage up to 20 products and their orders in Shopify. Includes a cart and one payment gateway integration.
services.e-commerce.extras: Platform fees, the domain and payment processing fees are separate.
services.pagina-web.name: Website
services.pagina-web.pain: Give customers a website where they can explore your services on their phone and send an inquiry through a contact form.
services.pagina-web.benefit: Turn a referral into a conversation with a site that makes your offer and next step clear.
services.pagina-web.scope: A responsive site with up to four sections, a contact form and basic search engine setup.
services.pagina-web.extras: Domain, hosting and ongoing maintenance are separate.
services.chatbots.name: Chatbots
services.chatbots.pain: Don’t lose sales because customers are left waiting. Automate your customer service workflows with custom chatbots.
services.chatbots.benefit: Answer routine questions right away and hand the conversations that need judgment to your team.
services.chatbots.scope: One chatbot channel, an FAQ knowledge base, human handoff and testing with real enquiries.
services.chatbots.extras: Messaging, model usage and ongoing support are separate.
services.apps.name: Apps
services.apps.pain: Have an idea to grow your business or improve your user experience? Let’s bring it to life with an app for iOS and Android.
services.apps.cta: Turn my idea into an app
services.apps.benefit: Put your team’s most-used workflow in an app they can take into the field.
services.apps.scope: A first release for iOS and Android focused on one workflow, with user sign-in, data entry and testing on both platforms.
services.apps.extras: External services, publishing accounts and additional platforms are separate.
services.juegos.name: Games
services.juegos.pain: Have an idea for a game? We design and develop original games tailored to your project.
services.juegos.benefit: Test your idea with a playable prototype and refine the mechanics before expanding the project.
services.juegos.scope: We work with you to define the core mechanics and scope of the first playable version. We build games for browser and desktop and can prepare them for distribution on platforms like Steam.
services.juegos.extras: Art, sound, multiplayer, and publishing are quoted based on the agreed scope.
services.agentes.name: AI agents
services.agentes.pain: Have processes to automate? Ready to bring your business into the AI era? We build agents that handle repetitive tasks in the tools you already use.
services.agentes.cta: Get a quote for AI agents
services.agentes.benefit: Let an agent prepare the record and give your team the final say before it is saved.
services.agentes.scope: One agent for one task, one integration, approval rules and an action log.
services.agentes.extras: API usage, licences and ongoing monitoring are separate.
services.sistemas-agenticos.name: Agentic systems
services.sistemas-agenticos.pain: How much time does your team lose coordinating work across disconnected tools? We connect your systems and use local AI models where they can lower costs.
services.sistemas-agenticos.benefit: We design the digital infrastructure that connects your data, tools and agents. We integrate local AI models when workload and hardware make them a cost-effective option.
services.sistemas-agenticos.scope: A two-agent pilot for one process, with context handoff, an activity trail and human approval at a critical step.
services.sistemas-agenticos.extras: Local model deployment, servers, additional integrations and external service usage are quoted based on scope.
services.capacitaciones-ia.name: AI training
services.capacitaciones-ia.pain: Everything you need to get more comfortable with AI tools and achieve better results. Training for businesses and individuals.
services.capacitaciones-ia.benefit: Bring a real task to the workshop and leave with a method your team can repeat the next day.
services.capacitaciones-ia.scope: A live three-hour workshop for up to four people, with a team exercise and a take-home guide.
services.capacitaciones-ia.extras: The price covers the full group online. Larger groups, travel and software licences are separate.
